question: Which Article of the Indian Constitution deals with the removal and suspension of a member of Public Service Commission?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Article 317**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The member of the Public Service Commission can be removed from the office by the** President of India.**
 
• Grounds, as well as procedure, is given in** Article 317** in the Constitution of India for removal and suspension of the members.
 
• The members can submit their resignation to the President of India at any time.
